annotations.title: Roof framing: rafter lengths, cuts, birdsmouth and templates

description: Lays out a gable or hip roof (optionally a gable wing with valleys) from the caller's own sizes: each common, hip, valley and jack rafter's length along the line, birdsmouth and HAP, plumb and cheek cuts as saw settings, hip backing, a cut list on the caller's stock, and a member's full-size template as SVG and DXF; both systems. Geometry only: it does not size structure.

detail.description: full (the default): the whole answer. summary: the result lines, the citation line and the page only — fewer tokens to read.

heightAbovePlate.description: The commons' height above the plate (HAP); left out, the seat bears on the whole plate.

hipDepth.description: Actual depth of the hips and valleys.

hipThickness.description: Actual thickness of the hips and valleys.

hipTop.description: Drop the hips and leave them square (default), or back them.

inputUnits.description: Send "base" to pass bare numbers on dimensioned inputs in base units (m, m², L, kg …), as the published test vectors are written. Without it a length, area or volume must carry its unit.

kerf.description: Saw kerf, charged on every cut (default 1/8 in or 3 mm).

lang.description: The answer's language. en (the default): as ever. es or es-US: US Spanish — labels, units, result lines and the honest machine-translation label from the site's Spanish pages, Spanish words read in a question or a trade term, and links to the /es/ pages once the site publishes them (until then the links stay English). fr or fr-CA (Canadian French, /fr/) and pt or pt-BR (Brazilian Portuguese, /pt/): the same from the site's French and Portuguese pages, figures with a decimal comma; each link names the translated page only once that page is published, otherwise the English page.

overhang.description: Level, from the wall's outer face to the tail's plumb cut.

pitch.description: Rise per 12 of run (6 for 6/12). Or give pitchDegrees.

pitchDegrees.description: The pitch in degrees, as an alternative to pitch.

plateWidth.description: The wall plate's width (the seat bears on it).

rafterDepth.description: Actual depth of the commons and jacks (a 2×8 is "7.25 in").

rafterThickness.description: Actual thickness of the commons and jacks ("1.5 in", "45 mm").

rake.description: Gable ends (and a wing's gable end): how far the roof runs past the gable wall.

spacing.description: Rafter centres along the plate ("16 in", "600 mm").

span.description: Building width across the ridge, outside faces of the wall plates ("24 ft", "8 m").

stock.description: The stock lengths the caller can buy, each with its unit; left out, the page's list for the system.

system.description: The system figures are read in and printed first (both are returned).

template.description: One member as a full-size template (1:1, millimetres).

kind.description: The member's ends only (default) or the whole member.

member.description: A member's key from this roof's answer: common, king-common, hip, hip-jack-1, valley, supporting-valley, …

wing.description: An equal-pitch gable wing on the front wall: gives the valleys, valley jacks and cripples.

offset.description: From the main roof's left end to the wing's centreline.

projection.description: From the main wall's face to the wing's end wall.

span.description: The wing's span, no wider than the main span.

name: roof_framing

cutList.description: Per board size: the pieces, the stock to buy from the caller's lengths, the waste, and any piece longer than every stock length (rafters are not joined).

language.description: Only with a lang other than en: the answer's language (es-US, fr-CA or pt-BR), whether its links may name the translated pages (spanishLinks for es-US; localeLinks for fr-CA and pt-BR, where an unpublished page still links in English), and the honest machine-translation label.

englishPages.description: Site page addresses in this answer that open the ENGLISH page, because the translated page is not published yet (the words in the answer may still be translated).

members.description: Every member: count and hands, lengths along the line, deductions, birdsmouth and HAP, cuts as saw settings, the hip's backing and drop.

board.description: The board the member needs, end to end at its long points.

lineLength.description: Heel point (or the foot's plumb line) to the top plumb line, along the measuring line, after the deductions.

topCut.description: plumbToEdge, sawMitre and sawBevel in degrees; topEdgeAngle for a cheek; what it cuts against.

template.description: One member at full size, as SVG and DXF in millimetres, with its facts and what it omits.

citation.description: The one citation line, built from the answer's own data.

language.description: Only with a lang other than en: the answer's language (es-US, fr-CA or pt-BR), whether its links may name the translated pages (spanishLinks for es-US; localeLinks for fr-CA and pt-BR, where an unpublished page still links in English), and the honest machine-translation label.

englishPages.description: Site page addresses in this answer that open the ENGLISH page, because the translated page is not published yet (the words in the answer may still be translated).

lines.description: The result lines, as the report's table gives them.

notes.description: What a professional must decide, when to call one, a false-friend warning, that adoption is local: kept in every summary.
